question:
The bar graph given below shows the sales of two companies C1 and C2 in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56cd7281e30390b76e3590a1edadc9f12d756bbe4795a7d20e3c4515e8ed4b37.png] 

JI - The average sale of company C1 in year Y1, Y2 and Y3.

J2 = The difference between total sale of company C1 and C2 in all the 5 yeas.

What is the value of (J2/J1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

J1 = The average sale of company C1 in year Y1, Y2 and Y3 = 200 + 400 + 600 = 1200/3 = 400

J2 = The difference between total sale of company C1 and C2 in all the 5 years = (1000 + 700 + 800 + 200 + 100) - (200 + 400 + 600 + 500 + 300)

⇒ 2800 - 2000 = 800

The value of (J2/J1) = 800/400 = 2

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
